title: Claims Desk Reference Card: Valuables Floater Reporting Deadlines
content:
**Claims desk reference card: Larkspur Valuables Floater reporting deadlines**

Two deadlines run from the moment a loss under the Larkspur Valuables Floater is discovered: the period within which the loss must be reported to Larkspur, counted in calendar days, and, for a theft, the time within which a police report must be made, counted in hours.

| Tier | Report the loss within (calendar days after discovery) | Police report for a theft within (hours after discovery) |
|---|---|---|
| Valuables Floater Classic | 60 | 72 |
| Valuables Floater Select | 60 | 72 |
| Valuables Floater Preferred | 60 | 72 |
| Valuables Floater Prestige | 60 | 72 |
| Valuables Floater Collector | 90 | 72 |
| Valuables Floater Private Client | 90 | 72 |

**At a glance**

- The Classic, Select, Preferred and Prestige tiers allow 60 calendar days to report a loss; the Collector and Private Client tiers allow 90.
- The police report window is 72 hours after discovering a theft on every tier.
- Both windows are counted from the discovery of the loss.
